prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Input image 1 is the floor-free 3D pose atlas EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is only the same atlas with magenta calibration squares to explain ground support and scale; do not reproduce those squares.
Primary request: Turn the crude 3D scaffold into finished hand-painted game character sprites. Refine the LOCAL SILHOUETTE and anatomy, shaped hair locks, expressive face, natural hands, tailored blue tunic with cloth folds, dark trousers, brown leather belt and anatomically shaped leather boots. Replace the primitive egg hair cap, capsule body/limbs and box boots with thoughtfully designed finished forms. This is a creative shape refinement, not a material-only repaint. Keep the same recognizable original adventurer in every panel.
Keep the reference's nominal body scale, skeleton action, body facing, stance and support/sole centers. The nominal standing head-to-ground scale is 160 runtime pixels above a fixed ground root, 1.25 calibration-cell widths; do not enlarge the head, torso, legs or shoes to add detail. Hair/fabric contours can change locally inside the existing head-to-foot scale and available frame. Back-facing panels show the back of the SAME hair and clothing. Preserve feet/support centers from the reference; shoe toes may naturally project forward.
Camera: fixed top-down oblique square-grid front-facing three-quarter RPG projection, no diamond rotation, no perspective convergence. Height projects straight upward; retain the exact camera, floor-center ground roots and panel sizes. Keep the full canvas and all empty gutters; complete isolated art only on genuine transparency. No calibration floor, no ground, no cast shadows, no outlines around panels, no labels, no extra objects.
Atlas requirement: preserve the entire 1728x1344 image as FOUR columns by TWO rows of eight full panels, with the same 64px transparent gutters. Each capture panel is 384x640. Their left positions are 0,448,896,1344, and row tops are 0,704. Keep all complete poses in those SAME positions without recentering, repacking, zooming or fitting. Runtime frames are 192x320 with fixed local ground root (96,248), doubled uniformly in this capture.
The exact row-major neutral standing facing order is north, northeast, east, southeast / south, southwest, west, northwest. Preserve the reference's rotation in each panel; do not turn all characters toward the camera. This is one original player shown in eight directions, with constant anatomy scale and lighting.
